description: This file implements a verification manager for handling cryptographic verification sessions, including initiation, acceptance, cancellation, and SAS/QR code verification flows within a Matrix client SDK.

classes.name: MatrixVerificationManager
classes.description: Manages cryptographic verification sessions, handles their lifecycle, and emits verification summaries.

methods.name: onSummaryChanged
methods.description: Registers a listener for verification summary updates.

methods.name: trackVerificationRequest
methods.description: Tracks a new verification request and creates a session for it.

methods.name: listVerifications
methods.description: Returns a list of current verification summaries.

methods.name: requestVerification
methods.description: Creates a new verification request based on parameters (own user, device, or room).

methods.name: acceptVerification
methods.description: Accepts a verification request by session ID.

methods.name: startVerification
methods.description: Starts verification with a specified method (currently only 'sas').

methods.name: generateVerificationQr
methods.description: Generates a QR code for verification.

methods.name: scanVerificationQr
methods.description: Scans a QR code to verify.

methods.name: getVerificationSas
methods.description: Retrieves SAS data for a verification session.
